<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a product of breaking down [[hemp seed]]s. It can either be crafted by using the [[vine press]] or purchased from the vendor [[Dig]]. Two flasks are currently required during gameplay: once in conversation with the [[donkey]], and once in conversation with [[Euric]] in the "Better Save Soul" DLC. Additionally, it serves as an [[oil]] concentrate (right click in inventory to convert to oil).
